title: British Adventurer Finishes 28-Year Walk Around the World
paragraphs: After 28 years, 50,000 kilometers and countless challenges, British adventurer Karl Bushby has finally completed his journey around the world — on foot.
The 57-year-old returned to his hometown of Hull, England, on November 2, where hundreds cheered him before an emotional reunion with his mother.
"Sorry to keep you waiting," he joked.
Bushby set out from Punta Arenas, Chile, on November 1, 1998, aged 29. His rules were simple: no transport to move him forward, and no returning home until he had completed the journey.
Over the next 28 years, he traveled through 30 countries across four continents, facing dangerous terrain, extreme weather and lengthy delays.

In 2001, he made his way through the dangerous Darién Gap, a rugged region of jungle and mountains between South and Central America. He was then jailed for 18 days after crossing a restricted border zone in Panama.

In 2006, he and fellow adventurer Dimitry Kieffer crossed the icy Bering Strait between Alaska and Russia. Along the way, they encountered a polar bear, fell into freezing water and nearly lost their supplies. They were later jailed for entering Russia illegally.
He also swam across the Caspian Sea and the English Channel.
Visa problems, the 2008 financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic caused years of delays.
Bushby originally thought his journey might take about five years, but he knew that was unrealistic.
"We suspected that it was 12 years plus," he said. "But never in our wildest dreams would we ever have imagined 28 years."

Although Bushby had met up with family members during his travels, he hadn't seen his mother in 10 years. He also reunited with his 36-year-old son, and met his 12-year-old granddaughter for the first time.
With his journey over, Bushby now faces the challenge of figuring out what to do next.
But there's plenty to keep him busy. He has several speaking engagements planned, a second memoir on the way and a documentary about his adventure being made.
